sections.heading: 1. Sit to dress + hip hinge
lines: ① Sit on the edge of the bed or a chair.
② Bring one foot onto the other knee.
③ Keep your back tall as you pull socks on.
④ Practise hip hinges, 10 reps, twice a day.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: Pain spreads below the knee, or your
leg goes numb — stop and get advice.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
For Koko, socks are the hardest part of the morning. Pulling them on means bending, balancing and reaching all at once, which is a lot to ask of an irritable back.

Sit on the edge of the bed, bring one foot up onto the opposite knee and keep your back tall. A long-handled shoehorn or slip-ons are sensible tools on flare-up days. Gentle hip hinges, little and often, usually help the movement feel easier again.

Pain spreading below the knee, or numbness or weakness in the leg, is worth an assessment first. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio combine hands-on care with simple exercises. Book online via the link in bio.
